episodes.title: Friendship Day
episodes.summary: Doodle mistakenly believes Sunny has forgotten him on Friendship Day and goes out in search of a new friend; when Doodle is taken by Scratch, the Dog Catcher, Sunny will stop at nothing to get her friend back.

episodes.title: The Topi-Hairy Contest
episodes.summary: Sunny enters the annual topiary tree sculpting contest, but when her entry is sabotaged — twice — by Lacey, she uses her hair-styling skills and some quick thinking to create a brand new kind of art.

episodes.title: Stick with Me
episodes.summary: When Rox and Blair accidentally get stuck together with sticky hairspray, it's up to Sunny to help them work together to get unstuck and save the day.

episodes.title: Sunny's Birthday Wish List
episodes.summary: Doodle, Rox, and Blair get creative to help Sunny fulfill her very special birthday wish list.

episodes.title: Puppy Love
episodes.summary: Doodle is smitten with a lost puppy, and with Sunny, Rox, and Blair's help, keeps the pup away from Scratch the Dog Catcher. The adventure leads to a daring rescue by Sunny and a surprise ending.

episodes.title: Style Swap
episodes.summary: When Blair meets her idol, Mandy the pop star, it's discovered they look exactly alike. Envious of each other's lives, the girls trade places for the day but soon learn the grass isn't always greener on the other side.

episodes.title: Sunny and the Princesses
episodes.summary: The girls style visiting Princesses and take the younger one, Annabella, on a fun-filled day around town. With Sunny's help, Annabella shows her sister Dominica the importance of trying new things, just in time for the ball.

episodes.title: Junior's Teddy Bear
episodes.summary: When Junior loses his beloved toy bear, Teddy, Sunny, and the gang search all over town only to discover Teddy has been right under their noses in the care of a surprising someone.

episodes.title: Top Dog
episodes.summary: Doodle enters the Perfect Pet Show Contest. With Sunny, Rox, and Blair's support, he overcomes obstacles, including Lacey and KC. In the final event, Doodle must decide if it's more important to win or help a friend in need.

episodes.title: Messenger Mix-up
episodes.summary: When Sunny goes in search of her missing delivery of hair chalk, she is sent on a wild goose chase around town. Can she find her hair chalks and style Mandy the pop star in time for Mandy's important music video shoot?

episodes.title: Pumpkin Pursuit
episodes.summary: Blair's beloved pumpkin costume is taken by Lacey right before the costume contest. Sunny, Rox, and Doodle help Blair track it down, but things go awry, leading Sunny to create a new kind of costume.

episodes.title: The Royal Visit
episodes.summary: Sunny and friends visit the palace for a royal ball welcoming Prince Dudley, the Princesses' egotistical cousin. Dudley soon finds himself in a tough spot, needing Sunny to rescue him, and discovers even princes need help sometimes.

episodes.title: If Timmy Gives You Apples
episodes.summary: When Timmy's enthusiasm for delivering apples gets the better of him, the girls soon find the salon overflowing with fruit. Sunny must find a kind way to tell Timmy to stop and come up with a clever use for all those apples.

episodes.title: Lacey's Salon
episodes.summary: Lacey opens her own salon to prove she's as good a stylist as Sunny. But when she ruins the hair of Dame Tralada, a visiting opera singer, Sunny must fix the Dame's hair and help Lacey realize where her true talents lie.

episodes.title: Wild Styled
episodes.summary: The girls head into the woods for a camping trip. When Blair gets lost after running from what she thinks is a scary spider, Sunny and Rox must use their styling tools and skills in unconventional ways to save their friend.

episodes.title: Best Christmas Ever
episodes.summary: Sunny and Doodle are separated when a snowstorm traps Doodle at his cousins' house on Christmas Eve. Sunny and the gang devise an intrepid plan to trek through the snow and reach Doodle in time to spend the holiday together.

episodes.title: Sunny's Not-So-Simple Concert
episodes.summary: Sunny and the girls stage a concert for Johnny-Ray to showcase his country music talent. But Sunny gets caught up in her plans and doesn't listen to Johnny-Ray's feelings, which could turn the concert into a disaster.

episodes.title: Clowning Around
episodes.summary: When Cousin Lulu runs off after accidentally ruining Junior's upcoming birthday party, it's up to Sunny, Rox, and Junior to track her down. Sunny discovers Lulu has a special skill; the perfect thing to save the party.

episodes.title: Poodle Puff Pals
episodes.summary: Lacey and KC have a falling out when KC gets fed up with Lacey not listening to her. Sunny tries helping them reconcile, but it takes a few failed attempts—and interference from Scratch—before the friends finally reunite.

episodes.title: Cirque Du Sunny
episodes.summary: Junior is disappointed the circus isn't coming to Friendly Falls, and Sunny's inability to contact the ringmaster doesn't help. So she decides to put on a show of their own...which proves more difficult than she thought.

episodes.title: The Royal Portrait
episodes.summary: Rox is excited about auditioning to make Prince Dudley's royal portrait, only for Dudley to appoint himself. When his portrait gets ruined, Rox finally gets her chance to shine, just in time for the portrait's big unveiling.

episodes.title: A Day at the Beach
episodes.summary: The Surf Bros, a musical duo, get lost on the way to their beach concert. Sunny and Doodle have to use some high-flying balloon skills and styling tricks to find the guys and save the concert.

episodes.title: Sleepover Surprise
episodes.summary: Everyone gets decked out in pajamas for a salon sleepover. When a mysterious visitor keeps interrupting the fun, Sunny & Co. devise a trap to catch the culprit — giving them all quite the surprise, and Rox a new pet bunny, Violet.

episodes.title: The Forever Home
episodes.summary: The gang helps Scratch run a dog adoption at the pound, where Blair bonds with a shy dog named Rosie. When Rosie isn't adopted and then finds herself in trouble, Blair steps up to save the day — and becomes Rosie's forever home.

episodes.title: Lulu the Woodland Fairy
episodes.summary: Lulu wants to become a Woodland Fairy, just like her cousin Rox. Sunny, Blair, and Doodle try helping Lulu, but they only seem to get in the way. When Sunny gets stuck, Lulu will finally get a chance to prove herself.

episodes.title: Sunny's Squad
episodes.summary: Sunny, Rox, Blair, and Junior are playing soccer in their new uniforms when the competitive Lacey challenges them to a game. It's a mostly one-sided contest, until Junior and Blair learn where their true talents lie.

episodes.title: Band Together
episodes.summary: Sunny and the gang put together a rock group to perform at the Friendly Falls Talent Show. When Lacey sabotages their performance, Sunny has to pull off some neat magic tricks to save the show.

episodes.title: Timmy's Big Day
episodes.summary: Sunny & Co. cover Timmy's jobs for the day, so he can live out his dream as a rock star and play with the Surf Bros. A chaotic, hijinks-filled day ends with an awesome concert and a new appreciation for everything Timmy does.

episodes.title: Pancake Party
episodes.summary: Suzette's birthday party is derailed when Johnny-Ray gets stuck in a hole with Timmy. Worse, Suzette and the pets get lost in the woods looking for Sunny & Co…who are also lost, requiring a wild farce to bring everyone together.

episodes.title: Cindy and the Cupcake Machine
episodes.summary: Lacey builds a cupcake machine to keep the bakery open while Cindy recovers from a wrist injury.

episodes.title: Dance Buddies
episodes.summary: Shy Cindy agrees to attend the "Buddy Dance" and convinces an equally shy shoe clerk, Rizwan, to attend as well. After a delivery mix-up jeopardizes the pair's chance to dance, Sunny has to lead them on a rescue mission.

episodes.title: Skating Siblings
episodes.summary: After Junior wins the town skateboarding contest, Rox questions her favorite hobby. A sudden, reluctant star, Junior is soon overmatched against a neighboring champion, leading Rox to rediscover her passion — and help her brother.

episodes.title: Violet's Adventure
episodes.summary: Violet takes Rox's skateboard for a wild ride around town. Though Rox doesn't catch up to Violet, an enamored Lacey does. When Violet again slips away, Sunny must help Rox pull off the ultimate ride to save her bunny.

episodes.title: A Different Duo
episodes.summary: Johnny-Ray wins a chance to perform with Fee-B, a rap music star. However, their styles don't mesh and they part ways. It'll take Johnny-Ray helping Fee-B, Sunny, and the girls out of a jam to realize what the pair can achieve.

episodes.title: Jump
episodes.summary: In this animated musical-comedy-adventure series, expert hairstylist Sunny uses her unique skills, positive attitude, and physical prowess to creatively solve problems and help friends in the colorful community of Friendly Falls.

episodes.title: Pet Parlor
episodes.summary: When the salon is overrun with pet clients, Doodle dreams up a Pet Parlor that the girls, in cool Pet Parlor outfits, build with Timmy's help. But before it can open, they'll need to find — and save — Dame Tralada's dog.

episodes.title: Parlor Problems
episodes.summary: Lacey and KC step in to manage the increasingly busy Pet Parlor, but lose track of Hannah's dog Tutu. It's not long before Sunny & Co. are roped into the farce, trying to undo a series of mix-ups before Tutu's big show.

episodes.title: A Berry Good Smell
episodes.summary: Sunny and Doodle lead a search for a special berry — the ingredient to Dame Tralada's favorite shampoo. But when a bird, who eats the berries, grows fond of — and scoops up — Her Majesty, the Dame is faced with a difficult decision.

episodes.title: Sunny and the Springtacular
episodes.summary: An excited Doodle offers to watch the famous baby chicks before the big Springtacular show. When Doodle loses track of them, he'll need Sunny's help to find the chicks in time for their performance with Dame Tralada.

episodes.title: Three-Headed Rose
episodes.summary: When Peter's prized flower wilts under Sunny, Rox, Blair, and Doodle's watch, they head to the woods to find another. Flower finding isn't easy, but the day is saved by a surprise from Peter — and a new hairstyle from Sunny.

episodes.title: The Royal Wedding
episodes.summary: Dominica and Annabella's prince Corgi, George, bonds with a spunky, scruffy stray named Ginger. The dogs are set for a royal wedding, but when Scratch interferes, it'll be up to Sunny & Co to save the dogs — and the wedding.

episodes.title: Doodle the Boss
episodes.summary: Seeing everyone performing their own special jobs at the salon inspires Doodle to start a smoothie stand. He soon realizes business ownership isn't for him, and when he gets in over his head, Sunny has to help bail him out.

episodes.title: Monkey Business
episodes.summary: Peter enlists Sunny and Doodle to help track down a playful monkey that was mistakenly delivered to his shop and is now loose in the town. It'll take Peter using his unique skills—with Sunny's help—to finally catch the monkey.

episodes.title: Get Her to the Vet
episodes.summary: Rosie is nervous about her first trip to the vet, Dr. Vanessa. After a series of misunderstandings and a high-speed chase result in Rosie being stuck, Sunny, Blair, and Martina must save Rosie — and get her to the vet! Guest Star: Cynthia Erivo

episodes.title: Sunny and the Groom & Vroom
episodes.summary: A broken Glam Van prevents everyone from traveling to a dog styling competition. Luckily, a strange new vehicle appears, inspiring Sunny to transform it into the ultimate, on-the-go pet styling vehicle: the Groom & Vroom.

episodes.title: Doodle and the Poodle
episodes.summary: When Doodle saves KC on her runaway bike, KC goes over the top in repaying Doodle's heroism. Doodle insists they're even, but KC won't accept it — that is, until Doodle finds himself in trouble and in need of a heroic KC.

episodes.title: Sunny-Go-Round
episodes.summary: Lacey's mechanical work in the Pet Parlor causes mayhem just before a new pet carousel is set to open. She and Sunny will have to style pets on-the-go in the Groom & Vroom in time to make it to the carousel's grand opening!

episodes.title: Princess Puppy Party
episodes.summary: Princess Ginger and Prince George are in town for Ginger's birthday party, but when the invitations aren't handed out, it's up to Sunny & Co, in the Groom & Vroom and Glam Van, to help round up Ginger's friends for the party.

episodes.title: Commercial Success
episodes.summary: Popular dog biscuit maker Bucky is in town looking for a dog to star in his new commercial. When Scratch's pursuit of a stray dog complicates things, Sunny steps up to help, leading to a surprise ending in more ways than one.

episodes.title: On Thin Ice
episodes.summary: After Rox and Blair accidentally destroy Doodle's beloved new sled, they vow to find a replacement. But that'll mean a farcical series of winter-related trades with their friends around town, including a hard-bargaining Lacey.

episodes.title: Bad Hairbot Day
episodes.summary: Picked to star in a fashion show, a busy Rox creates a coloring robot, HairBot, to help her with customers. When HairBot goes haywire around town, it's up to Rox and her coloring skills to save the day—and the fashion show.

episodes.title: Blair's Appointment
episodes.summary: A series of mishaps prevents Blair from getting to her house call across town—the first time she'll have ever missed an appointment. Determined, she adventures through tough terrain, doing whatever it takes to make it on time.

episodes.title: All at Sea
episodes.summary: While Sunny & Co help Timmy fix the lighthouse, Doodle, Rosie, and Violet get stuck on a boat in the bay. It'll be up to Sunny to rescue them while the others rush to get the lighthouse working before a dense fog rolls in.

episodes.title: Double Trouble
episodes.summary: When Sunny's picnic is put on hold, she makes the most of the day by helping Blair and Rox with their events. Once their events start, though, Blair and Rox realize they now have the chance to do something nice for Sunny.

episodes.title: The Flower Parade
episodes.summary: When a balloon mishap accidentally sends Sunny and Doodle soaring into the sky right before the Flower Parade, it's up to Blair and Rox to find a way to get their friends back on the ground, and in time for the parade.

episodes.title: A Hairy Situation
episodes.summary: After Lacey makes a mistake on KC's hair, Sunny helps KC grow it back. But when KC lets her hair get a little too big, it becomes a problem for everyone, and could ruin Lacey and Cindy's family night at the theater.

episodes.title: Chasing Rainbows
episodes.summary: After Rox tells Junior an exciting fairy tale, they decide to live out the tale in real life. When their adventure packed day doesn't end the way they thought it would, it's up to Rox to create a new kind of magical ending.

episodes.title: Blair's Day Off
episodes.summary: A girl named Rhiannon comes to the salon, eager to learn about nails from Blair. When Sunny, Rox, and Dame Tralada become stuck in a mountain cabin, Blair and Rhiannon lead a rescue mission, putting their skills to the test.

episodes.title: Pin Pals
episodes.summary: KC's excited to bowl with Lacey in an upcoming tournament, but Lacey keeps putting her own interests above teamwork and friendship. When KC decides it's time for a new partner, Lacey will need Sunny's help to make things right.

episodes.title: Sunny and the Fireworks Festival
episodes.summary: The Friendly Falls Fireworks Festival has everyone buzzing. But when Sunny accidentally puts the event in jeopardy, she's got to work with her friends to make things right in time for the big fireworks show.
